name: contract-method-headings
goal: Show CRUD actions first and concise color-separated callable headings across shared contracts

evidence: ProviderSwitch Contract currently lists find and findBy before create, and headings duplicate table types. Expected shared callable headings contain only method and parameter names with distinct colors, with declared CRUD methods first.

Standard model-contract-table, service-contract and entity-contract tests asserted typed headings and did not constrain CRUD order. Extended these existing suites and shared model fixture, plus standard model and service browser checks, preserving type tables, legacy metadata, multi-class names and noncallable shapes.
